study.title: Resolution-Accuracy Trade-offs in UAV-Based Semantic Segmentation for Precision Agricultural Imagery
study.short_title: Agriculture-Vision GSD study: U-Net3+ best mIoU 79.9% @20 cm/px
study.venue: Indonesian Journal of Electrical Engineering and Informatics (IJEEI)

segmentation.domain: Quantifies the effect of Ground Sampling Distance (10, 20, 40 cm/pixel) on UAV-based agricultural anomaly semantic segmentation (each anomaly = binary task): weed clusters, dryness, nutrient deficiency, double plant, water, water way, planter skip, endrow
segmentation.best_model: U-Net3+ at 20 cm/pixel: mIoU 79.9% (best overall across the model x GSD grid and the most resolution-robust architecture; also best at 40 cm with 76.94%). At 10 cm/pixel plain U-Net is best (72.89%). Hybrid BCE+Dice+Focal loss (weights 0.3/0.3/0.4) for class imbalance

dataset.name: Agriculture-Vision (CVPR 2020): large aerial image database of farmland with RGB + NIR UAV-acquired channels at up to 10 cm/pixel, annotated for 8 agricultural anomaly patterns; images downscaled for the 20 and 40 cm/pixel conditions
dataset.note: Paper evaluates three GSD levels: 10, 20, 40 cm/pixel. Per-class splits used independently per anomaly (e.g. weed cluster 10,000/555/556 train/val/test; dryness 15,125/840/841; nutrient deficiency 11,250/625/625 etc.). Resized/normalized inputs with rotation & flip augmentation.

segmentation.backbone: Fully convolutional CNNs trained per anomaly class as binary segmentation; architecture families U-Net / U-Net++ / U-Net3+ / Attention U-Net / R2U-Net / DeepLabV3+; hybrid BCE+Dice+Focal (0.3/0.3/0.4, alpha 0.25, gamma 2.0); no Transformer models benchmarked (motivated as unsuitable for UAV deployment)

mIoU.quote: At medium resolution (20 cm/pixel) there is a remarkable change in performance. U-Net3+ achieves best mIoU (79.9%) which is better than all the other models
mIoU.section: 3.2 Quantitative Performance Analysis Across Resolutions / Table 4
mIoU.ambiguity: Study-wide best mIoU over the model x GSD grid (U-Net3+, 20 cm/pixel). Same model at 10 cm: 0.6841, at 40 cm: 0.7694. Alternative bests by resolution: U-Net 10 cm 0.7289; U-Net3+ 40 cm 0.7694. mIoU = mean per-class Jaccard over the 8 binary anomaly tasks.

mPA.ambiguity: Per-task 'Accuracy' (PA) reported per model/class in Tables 1/3/5 (e.g. weed cluster U-Net3+ 20 cm: 0.9402) but no class-averaged mPA.

F1.ambiguity: Precision and recall reported per class; F1 scores not tabulated.

Dice.ambiguity: Class-level Dice coefficient (DC), highest single value reported: U-Net on Water Way at both 10 and 20 cm/pixel. The headline best config (U-Net3+, 20 cm) reaches DC 0.9135 on weed cluster; per-class DC across the grid spans ~0.20-0.95. Values are per-class, not averaged.

PA.ambiguity: Only per-task pixel accuracy is given; no aggregate PA for our PA field.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Weed cluster only reported via JC/accuracy/precision/recall (e.g. 20 cm U-Net3+ JC 0.8411, acc 0.9402); no F1.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Crop canopy is not an explicit class in this anomaly-segmentation benchmark.

edge.device: Not specified (training-time analysis only; no inference-hardware details given)

fps.ambiguity: No inference FPS/latency reported; only per-epoch training 'Time(s)' in Tables 1/3/5.

params_M.ambiguity: Param counts not reported; model sizes in MB vary with architecture (U-Net 26 MB, U-Net++ 24, U-Net3+ 20, Attention U-Net 25, R2U-Net 75, DeepLabV3+ 137).

issues: edge.reported=false: no on-device/edge metrics; hardware platform not disclosed; only per-epoch training time comparisons.

Headline value is the best cell of a model x GSD grid (U-Net3+ @ 20 cm/pixel, mIoU 79.9%) and is task- and resolution-dependent: plain U-Net wins at 10 cm (72.89%), U-Net3+ wins at 20 (79.9%) and 40 cm (76.94%).
Binary-per-anomaly segmentation on Agriculture-Vision (8 classes, not crop-vs-weed); weed cluster is one class (its best JC = 0.8411 at 20 cm, U-Net3+).

Core finding: higher GSD does NOT guarantee higher accuracy - large-area anomalies (dryness, nutrient deficiency, weed clusters) match or beat high-res at 20-40 cm/pixel at much lower compute; fine-grained anomalies (endrow, planter skip) benefit from 10 cm/pixel.
Hybrid BCE+Dice+Focal loss; multi-scale aggregation architectures most robust to downsampling; model file sizes U-Net family 20-26 MB vs R2U-Net 75 MB / DeepLabV3+ 137 MB.
